prompts.01-garden-gate:
Use case: ui-mockup, one full-bleed 16:9 horizontal game start / level-selection screen for the actual original Rongboy 绒仔 game, at desktop MacBook resolution. The three supplied files are REFERENCES only: 1 actual in-game woolball FPS garden for material and scale, 2 exact hero identity sandy khaki adventurer hat and mustard scarf, 3 the previous menu for functional requirements only. Preserve real art direction: needle-felt, hand sewn round forms with short fuzzy fibers, real macro miniature photography, natural shadows, dark green and oat, selective mustard highlights. It should feel like a polished console game menu with strong visual hierarchy, obvious large focused action and large legible CJK typography, full bleed content to every edge. No device bezel, no collage, no slide, no credits, no fake mouse, no skin store, no crosshair/ammo HUD. Each distinct location should be recognizable: 家 = three-storey felt house and lawn/garden, 博物馆 = blue-hour dinosaur gallery with skylights, 学校 = felt school corridor and playground, 奶奶家 = lower warm cottage and vegetable patch. Exactly these four destinations, a clear selected state, one contextual game-start button, keyboard and gamepad footer. All text Chinese set exactly as specified; restrained plain type rather than text imprinted on noisy art. The interface is functional, no decorative labels/filler, no unreadably tiny copy.
Art direction A, INSIDE THE GAME. Low eye-level FIRST PERSON view, going to the real felt house through a slightly open ivory stitched picket gate at the edge of a big garden. Bottom right a specific tiny cream and warm-caramel woolball spool launcher with spherical golden yarn, cream muzzle and khaki cloth forearms in low-ready pose, covering at most 17% of the scene. Frame house and open gate primarily center-right; one small, cute olive felt zombie with X button eyes partly hidden behind low hedge far enough away to feel like a discovery. Quiet warm late afternoon with patches of gentle dappled light, dusty atmosphere. Luxuriant but readable physical texture. Keep darkened, lower-detail foliage and dark olive vignette in the left 35% for menu. No monster looming at the camera. Deep, cinematic step playable entrance rather than a painting. Upper left title “绒仔” large flowing original typographic wordmark and “RONGBOY” small below. Below title a simple left vertical list exactly “家”, “博物馆”, “学校”, “奶奶家”; first selected with a clear muted ochre edge/selection and cream type, other three clearly legible against shadow. Directly below list one broad solid wheat button “进入花园”. On the right just leave the full natural scene as preview, no right-hand content column. Bottom left small unified footer “↑ ↓ 选关　Enter 出发　✕ 出发”. The title shouldn't compete with the scene. Distribute UI with intentional breathing room. One stunning, plausible photograph of a miniature FPS title screen in a natural state.

Art direction B, A REAL POP-UP FELT MAP AS THE MENU. An almost top-down/isometric view of a single OPEN fabric-covered book, very generously occupying the screen, top and bottom visible on a warm dark wooden workbench, only a couple of tiny sewing pins/lens props at margins, no clutter. The right two thirds of the opened spread contain a spatial pop-up miniature world instead of panels: exactly four clearly separate, differently shaped stitched felt islands with tangible recognisable buildings, the biggest foreground island selected softly by a golden stitch outline: the familiar 3-storey felt house + garden, with tiny olive X-button zombie beside a hedge. Behind it three physically smaller destination islands linked by a dotted yarn route: museum with tiny skeleton, school with roof and chalkyard, grandmas little cottage and garden. Four neat ivory fabric name tabs right at each island, exact text “家”, “博物馆”, “学校”, “奶奶家” once each. Readable real 3D relief, stitched borders, small shadows. Hero seen only as tan hat and khaki sleeve edge at bottom corner like leaning over the table, if needed. Left one third is a pale virtually blank linen page with generous margins, readable black spruce type, title “绒仔” with “RONGBOY” beneath. Below it large title “家” and one short objective “找回毛线篮”. Broad forest green action button “进入花园”. At bottom left “← → 选关　Enter 出发　✕ 出发”. No left navigation list; the tactile map IS the selector. Do not make an illustrated travel poster. Make it a functional, warm, play-along opening screen with an immediately recognizable focus and easy text contrast.

Art direction C, PLAYABLE CONSOLE CHAPTER SELECT. Strong cinema fill frame: one enormous, highly detailed, wide-angle interior of the actual cozy felt museum at blue hour, amber desk and cyan moonlight through big museum skylight, cheerful needle-felt dinosaur skeleton that feels handmade, a pair of small olive plush figures barely visible in distance. The hero, accurate khaki hat and blue-green bag, seen from behind on the far right margin at lower third, leaning in to peer from behind an exhibit, toy woolball gun held low. The play space fills 80% of composition, dark olive-black subtle lower gradient for excellent focus contrast. Upper left simple large “绒仔” with small “RONGBOY”. Above the bottom bar on left, one big selected location title “博物馆” and a single short mission “找回三件展品”. At bottom along 75% width on one horizontal row, four equally spaced landscape chapter thumbnails, actual scene art cropped inside, in order “家”, “博物馆”, “学校”, “奶奶家”; second state brightly outlined with solid ochre active tab, others subdued but high contrast. To the right of the thumbnails below the selected scene a single warm prominent action “进入博物馆”. Along bottom edge in small but readable type “← → 选关　Enter 出发　✕ 出发”. No mockups within mockup, no homepage panels or boxed hero gallery, screen is calm and readable. Rich petrol/navy textile and amber lamplight, arresting space, clear action.
